objective: Continuous strategy discovery, prospective data collection, qualification, and policy-gated execution with explicit separation between research and capital.

responsibilities: maintain source, tests, deployment configuration, and agent routing
triage failed workflows and produce reproducible fixes
coordinate scheduled research and verify-only broker evidence
never self-authorize live capital or modify release gates to bypass failed evidence
review evidence, research methodology, risk controls, and release decisions
identify blockers and propose auditable changes
not claim to run persistent background processes or directly control Claude Code without a connected runtime
own balance truth, account isolation, risk checks, execution authorization, transaction verification, and ledger reconciliation
reject stale, invalid, drifted, uncalibrated, or out-of-policy trade probability
keep external agents and repositories outside capital authority

control_heartbeat.purpose: check repository source identity and fail-closed release invariants

public_market_research.purpose: collect prospective public R100 observations and update research evidence

verify_only_broker_evidence.purpose: verify broker prerequisites only when protected credentials exist; no live orders

runtime_probe.purpose: bounded runtime and public-data checks, not a persistent always-on trading daemon

operational_limitations: GitHub scheduled workflows are periodic jobs, not a guaranteed 24/7 daemon; schedules may be delayed or disabled by platform/account policy.
The repository cannot prove that Claude Code is running continuously unless an actual connected host or agent runtime reports authenticated heartbeats.
ChatGPT conversation does not itself execute a persistent background process or control an external Claude Code process.

No live order is permitted while broker authentication, verified balance/stake affordability, qualified out-of-sample strategy evidence, deployment health, and transaction reconciliation gates are incomplete.
